Title: Reliaburger 0.2.0 online workshop
Description:
Want to spend an hour breaking a cluster?

Reliaburger is an open-source container orchestrator in a single binary: one agent per node, one CLI, and no control plane to assemble. Scheduling, ingress, service discovery, secrets, a registry, metrics, logs and fault injection are all built in. It runs your existing Kubernetes manifests. https://reliaburger.com/

Together, step by step, we'll:

- set up a small cluster on your own laptop
- launch a real web app and open it in your browser
- slow it down and switch parts of it off on purpose
- watch it notice the problem and fix itself

Bring: a Mac, or Linux with QEMU/KVM, plus ~8 GB free RAM and 15 GB of disk.

See you there!

Title: Reliaburger 0.3.0 online workshop
Description:
Would you let a robot cook a burger for you?

Never touched Kubernetes, or touched it once and backed away slowly?

This one's for you. Reliaburger is an open-source container platform that skips the complexity entirely: one binary, one CLI, and everything already inside. No control plane to assemble, no add-ons to pick, no YAML archaeology. You don't need to be an infra person, just curious! https://reliaburger.com/

Together, step by step, we'll:

- spin up a three-node cluster on your laptop with one command, in about five minutes
- deploy a real web app (a burger, layer by layer) and open it in your browser
- ship a bad release and watch it roll itself back
- let an AI agent suggest a change, then approve it yourself
- break things on purpose: kill parts of the app, make it slow, switch off a whole machine
- watch it notice the problem and fix itself

Bring a Mac with Apple silicon, or Linux with QEMU/KVM, plus about 8 GB of free RAM and 15 GB of disk. No Rust, no Kubernetes knowledge, no setup beforehand.

See you there!
